about: Which files each persona may write, from decisions/007. Paths are relative to the repo root. Patterns apply in order and the last match wins; ! takes a path back out. A persona with an empty list writes nothing; a persona that isn't listed writes nothing. The cockpit (main session) isn't restricted. Copying the team to another project means rewriting this file and each persona's 'In this repo' section.

addOnly.about: Shared code (spec 004 FR-032). check-branch.mjs flags a branch that changes or removes an existing file here, unless the cockpit passes --shared-owner for the one branch it named owner. Adding new files is fine: each skill adds its own tool file, which mentor/tools/index.mjs finds.
